node_types.description: A backend Python module under backend/app, named by its dotted path (app.services.rag.retrieval). The unit of the Python import graph.
A TypeScript module under frontend/src, named by its repo-relative path. The unit of the frontend import graph.
A Next.js App Router page (page.tsx), locale segment normalized away, route groups contributing no URL segment.
A Next.js API route handler under frontend/src/app/api that fronts backend REST calls. The mandatory hop in every browser-to-backend REST chain.
A FastAPI route: method plus path template as the backend declares it.
A Taskiq background task, registered by @broker.task decorator plus the explicit imports in the worker app.
A SQLAlchemy ORM model class under backend/app/db/models.
A test module under backend/tests or frontend test trees, linked to what it exercises by TESTS edges.
An agent-callable tool. Google product tools are rows of the DIRECT_GOOGLE_PRODUCTS registry — data, not AST-visible functions; MCP tools are runtime-discovered and enter only as runtime evidence.
An environment variable by name, never by value. Declared in settings or env templates, consumed by components.
A governed component from the effective manifest: the ownership grain impact analysis reports in.
